text_en: China's Shanghai Composite Index closed up 2.93 points, or 0.08%, at 3,663.72 on Tuesday, November 10; China's Shenzhen Component Index closed up 96.05 points, or 0.86%, at 11,241.54 on Tuesday, November 10; China's CSI 300 Index closed up 3.0 points, or 0.07%, at 4,059.11 on Tuesday, November 10; China's ChiNext Index closed up 35.84 points, or 1.46%, at 2,494.4 on Tuesday, November 10; China's STAR 50 Index closed up 8.06 points, or 0.64%, at 1,265.02 on Tuesday, November 10.
